categories.main_business_segments: Meitec Group Holdings operates primarily in three business segments: Engineering Solutions (mainly high-end engineer dispatch services), Engineer Placement (specialized recruitment for engineers), and Other (group management and administrative services). The Engineering Solutions segment is the core, accounting for over 90% of consolidated sales, and includes subsidiaries focused on high-end, mid-range, senior, and manufacturing-related engineer dispatching.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core competency lies in the dispatch and development of highly skilled engineers, particularly in mechanical and electrical fields, to client companies for design and development projects. Their operational strength is based on a proprietary matching system that optimizes the allocation of engineers to client needs, and a strong focus on continuous training and career development to maintain high technical and human skill standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Meitec Group primarily serves large Japanese manufacturing companies, especially in the automotive, electronics, machinery, and industrial sectors. Their main customers are R&D and technical departments of major manufacturers seeking advanced engineering talent for design, development, and innovation projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with all major subsidiaries and business activities based domestically. While there have been some overseas ventures in the past, over 90% of sales and assets are generated within Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Meitec operates as a downstream service provider in the supply chain, supplying high-value human capital (engineers) directly to manufacturers and technology companies, supporting their product development and innovation processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Meitec focuses on strengthening its core engineer dispatch business through quality hiring, career development, and operational efficiency. The group’s mid-term plan (M2CX) emphasizes transformation of both customer and engineer value, digitalization, and adapting to technological trends such as AI and automation. There is no significant in-house R&D for products, but substantial investment in human resource development and digital matching systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through hourly-based engineer dispatch contracts with client companies. Additional revenue comes from engineer placement fees in the recruitment segment and management fees/dividends from group companies in the holding company segment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Meitec is the leading company in Japan’s engineer dispatch industry, recognized for its scale, quality, and long-term client relationships. Key competitors include other large staffing and engineer dispatch firms such as Pasona, Outsourcing Inc., and TechnoPro, but Meitec is distinguished by its focus on high-end engineering and its reputation for quality and stability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Meitec Group reported consolidated sales of 133.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of 12.7 billion yen, both record highs. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profits over the past five years, maintains a strong equity ratio (52%), and employs over 13,000 people, with a stable cash position and high profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Meitec’s value proposition is its ability to provide highly skilled, immediately productive engineers who can contribute to clients’ core R&D and innovation activities. The company differentiates itself through rigorous engineer selection, continuous professional development, high matching accuracy, and a reputation for reliability and compliance, making it a trusted partner for Japan’s leading manufacturers.
